events.text:
I closed T-246 as done: no attendee funnel was ever deployed from production, so nothing runs the old worker and there was nothing to redeploy or check.

1. **Counts:** I signed in with the admin key and read `/admin/api/attendees`. There are 26 attendees and all 26 are test accounts; the overview shows 0 live. None of them has a funnel URL: `plan_url` is empty on every row and none has a device. The 07:11 export also showed 0 funnel records and 0 Cloudflare connections.
2. **Unsigned Zoom check:** I sent none, because there was no funnel to send it to. I redeployed nothing and changed no setting.
3. **Records:** The counts are written into the T-246 log and added as one line to the coord `LOG.md`.
4. **Status:** T-246 is set to done. Both done-when lines hold because there are 0 live attendees. I acked note F-cba1377b.

One gap: the attendees list doesn't show funnel URLs at all (they live in a per-attendee funnel record). So "0 with a funnel" also leans on this morning's export, which I didn't call again because it wasn't an approved step today.

I didn't make a commit, because I changed no files in the repo. The board update goes through `pass.py`, and the coord log is outside this checkout.
